data.value: Will at least one of the forty procurement leads that Brightline Software's rep Gustavo cold-emails this week agree to a discovery call before the end of the month?

Gustavo has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He can send cold emails to them via standard email channels. The leads may or may not respond to such emails. A discovery call is a scheduled phone or video conversation to discuss the software.
